data.name: Source Name
data.description: Concise, unique identifier assigned to each study source. Serves to distinguish individual components within the study.

data.name: Organism
data.description: The organism used in the study.

data.name: Organism description
data.description: Free text description of the strain. Could be related to strain construction, purpose/intended goal, ...

data.name: Geographic location (country and/or sea)
data.description: The geographic location from which the organism was obtained.

ontology.name: Geographical Locations
ontology.description: Ontology for geographical locations, including countries and seas.

data.name: Input Registered Source
data.description: Registered Sample in the platform used as input for the protocol.

data.name: Sample Collection Protocol
data.description: Provide details on the experimental or technical procedures used during the sample creation or collection process. This may include information about the methods, techniques, or protocols employed to obtain the sample.

data.name: Sample Name
data.description: Unique identifier assigned to each sample within a study. It is a short string that serves as the source sample name in DataHub.

data.name: Title
data.description: Descriptive label for a sample, summarizing its key characteristics or context in the study.

data.name: Sample Description
data.description: Free text explanation of the specific sample. It offers context about the purpose, methodologies, and scope of the sample, enabling researchers and repository users to understand its role within the overall study.

data.name: Collection Date
data.description: The date on which the sample was collected.

data.name: Accession
data.description: European Nucleotide Archive (ENA) experiment accession code. Provided by ENA after submission.

data.name: Submission Date
data.description: Date in which experiment was submitted to European Nucleotide Archive (ENA) repository. Provided by programmatic ENA upload tool

data.name: Status
data.description: Status of programmatic submission to ENA. As a user, select 'Add', 'Modify' or 'Cancel' to add, modify or delete the sample to/from the ENA repository if the upload is performed.
